title: @better-auth/passkey 1.4.0-beta.16 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, and the passkey plugin in…
description: @better-auth/passkey versions 1.4.0-beta.16 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5, along with the passkey plugin in better-auth versions 1.2.0-beta.18 before 1.4.0, do not properly enforce WebAuthn user verification when it is set to "required". They also incorrectly take the expected origin from the request rather than from a secure configuration. This flaw allows users to register or authenticate using passkeys without the necessary PIN or biometric verification, and passkey responses from another origin under the same relying party ID may be accepted.
